object_description: compact seven-story block with side loggias and roof terraces
design_condition: Placed across the plot, the block creates a natural forecourt at the main entrance and spacious lateral outdoor areas, while its compressed relationship with the existing school produces a convincing visual composition.

positive.statement: The placement creates an appropriate forecourt and lateral outdoor spaces with welcome spaciousness beside the compact building.

position.rationale: Open areas surround the compact central mass, with the forecourt plausibly located along the south-facing approach.

positive.statement: The four outdoor areas take on specific tasks and are designed accordingly.

position.rationale: The sampled plan shows several lateral and front open zones around the compact building.

positive.statement: The open-space design is well thought out, developed, and optimally tailored to the modest space available.

position.rationale: A distributed site-edge marker represents the developed open-space region around the limited footprint.

positive.statement: The central access zone allows both the main address and a side entrance, while the catering and multi-purpose areas connect well to the attractive outdoor space.

position.rationale: The central south-side zone is the most plausible location for the main address and side access.

positive.statement: The classrooms are well lit and flexibly divisible because their long sides face the facade.

position.rationale: Classroom locations are inferred along the facade-facing floor bands visible in the elevations.

positive.statement: The spacious lounges and roof terraces offer a high-quality connection to the outdoors on each floor.

position.rationale: Upper-level terrace and setback patterns are visible near the roof perimeter and across repeated elevations.

positive.statement: The loggias and structural hierarchy cleverly overplay the building's large scale and make the main entrance legible.

position.rationale: Repeated recessed facade bands and the likely south entrance establish the marker on the front elevation.

positive.statement: The additional connection to the sports hall ensures its operation outside school hours.

negative.statement: The classroom floor heights are relatively low as a result of the seven-story structure.
